limitations: Fresh browser contexts with HTTP cache disabled, warm local Next development server, unthrottled device. Three samples per route are diagnostics, not a hosted capacity or production-speed claim.
Chromium native sandbox unavailable in executor; isolated localhost-only contexts and non-GET denial.
CDP encodedDataLength includes observed completed requests by sampling time. Dev-server HMR may remain open and is excluded from completed-request bytes.
